article.title: Cross examination of person called to produce a document
article.content: A person summoned to produce a document does not become a witness by the mere fact that he produces it, and cannot be cross-examined unless and until he is called as a witness.
article.html:
144Cross examination of person called to produce a document

Section 144 · Part IV · Chapter X

A person summoned to produce a document does not become a witness by the mere fact that he produces it, and cannot be cross-examined unless and until he is called as a witness.
